あらすじ

Touma started his career at the Saint Laird company fresh out of school. There he met the beautiful and caring senpai Mai, who is quick to get jobs done.   • 英語名: Yakimochi Kanojo no Ichizu na Koi

あらすじ

Aoba is a member of cooking club and is always harshly treated by Iori, another member of the club. People in Aoba’s surroundings clearly see through Iori’s motivation being love, but Aoba doesn’t notice it at all until after a year, Iori confesses and demands to have sex with him. On top of that, after the act itself she demands for him to forget about it.

  • 英語名: Kanojo to Ore to, Koisuru Resort Kanojo to Ore to Koibito to. & Koisuru Natsu no Last Resort W Fan Disc

あらすじ

This is the double fandisc for Tototo and Koirizo, taking place a year after Koirizo with the Tototo cast visiting Rosemary Island Resort. There are after stories for all the characters, five 3P scenes (Ayano/Susuki, Tsukushi/Konoka, Yuuko/Chikage, Sango/Konami, Yuuhi/Nagisa) and routes for subcharas Yuuhi and Konami. There’s also a sun-tanned swimsuit patch. Enjoy your summer!

item.title: Koisuru Natsu no Last Resort
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: PULLTOP LATTE
  • 発売日: 2014-03-28
  • スコア: 6.83/10 (2222 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋する夏のラストリゾート
  • 英語名: Koisuru Natsu no Last Resort

别名

  • Be my summer love in the last paradise!

あらすじ

Soutarou just manages to pay his school fees by doing part-time jobs. After helping his kouhai Umi and skipping his shift, he was fired from his part-time job and was having problems making ends meet. Umi felt responsible for his present situation and introduced him to a part-time job at a Southern resort. With deep blue skies, clear seas and vibrant vegetation, the place looked exactly like in the travel magazines.
